otherChanges: Preservation receipts reduced to aggregate results and original hashes.
Raw accessibility dumps, helper scripts and redundant/nonessential screenshots omitted.
screenshots: Six screenshots visually inspected. Copied byte-for-byte, with no pixel alteration. Other screenshots with owner identity/source-record details or hover URLs were omitted.
credentials: Candidate text is checked for private keys, token/JWT patterns, credential-bearing URLs, sensitive environment values and personal identifiers before staging. No environment files, cookies, authorization headers or session storage are included.
originalArtifacts: Original local release artifacts and all committed pre-release evidence remain unchanged.
